When a magazine is so interesting that the reader says "I was sorry because there was no more to read" it is very valuable as an advertising medium, because, when "there is no more to read," the advertisements are invariably read with the same zest and enthusiasm as the reading matter.

Advertisements read in this frame of mind always leave an after-thought and are more likely to "make the sale."
